messages:
maya: Hey team — day 1 questions on security onboarding. I got my account invite and Okta set up, but running into two things: MDM enrollment on my personal Mac is stuck at 'Downloading profile' and the company VPN won't connect (keeps timing out). Also I need KMS access for a test project (redwood-test) — do I request it somewhere specific? I saw a phish sim invite in my inbox but no details on the window. Who should I ping for each of these? TL;DR: MDM stuck, VPN timeout, KMS request path, phish-sim schedule. Thanks!

ashley: Welcome @maya! :tada: For MDM please follow the onboarding doc: https://redwood.example/docs/onboarding-mdm — look for the "macOS enrollment" section. If it hangs at 'Downloading profile' try removing any previous company profiles (System Settings → Profiles) then re-run the installer. If that doesn't work, screenshot the error and ping me and IT. We also have a BYOD form for personal laptops if you want to keep dev access but limit prod creds: https://redwood.example/forms/byod.

samir: Adding security context — for KMS access we use the key-request form: https://redwood.example/internal/key-requests. Provide service name, repo link, justification, and manager approval. For HSM-backed keys you need sec + manager sign-off and we typically require a short onboarding call. Phishsim is mandatory for all new hires and runs for 30 days starting from the invite date; you should receive 2 reminder emails. Exemptions (rare) go through the security exceptions form — include contract/role justification.

devin: For VPN timeouts, first check Okta device approval: sometimes Okta shows a pending device approval popup. Also try these quick steps: 1) restart the machine; 2) open the Okta web app and sign in once; 3) then open the VPN client. If it's still failing, run this and paste output: `profiles -L` (mac) or `ipconfig /all` (win). If you need immediate access we can issue a temporary loaner badge for on-site VPN or provision a jumpbox.

maya: Thanks — quick follow-ups: 1) Is full-disk encryption required on personal machines to get dev access? 2) If I submit the key-request form can someone expedite (I just need read access to test retrieval)?

security-bot: Reminder: New hire security training due in 7 days. Course: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Phish sim emails come from training@phishsim.io — check spam folder.

ashley: FileVault (mac) / BitLocker (win) is required for any device that will store production credentials or access prod infra. For BYOD that only touches non-prod work we recommend encryption but it's not enforced — you still need to sign the BYOD agreement. If you want an air-gapped or company-managed laptop for prod access we can provision one.

jordan: FYI badge pickup is at the facilities desk at 2pm today. @maya reply here if you want us to hold one for you. Also we usually schedule a short security orientation with sec in the first week — about 15m to go over KMS/HSM rules.

maya: I'll book badge pickup, thanks. I filed the key-request form (redwood-test) and included my manager's approval in the notes. Can someone confirm when you can process expedite?

samir: I see the request — I'll mark it for expedite once you paste the request ID here. Note: for read access we sometimes grant ephemeral creds first. You can use the ephemeral key endpoint for quick testing: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" https://dev-api.redwood.ai/ephemeral-keys -d '{"scope":"kms:read","ttl":3600}'` — replace $DEV_TOKEN with your dev token.

devin: If MDM is misbehaving on macs try this cleanup snippet: ```bash
# remove old profiles and re-enroll
sudo profiles -R -p com.apple.mdm
sudo profiles -I -F ~/Downloads/redwood-mdm.mobileconfig
sudo reboot
```
If you still see 'Downloading profile' after reinstall, send the mdm logs from Console → MDM.

maya: Awesome, that helps a lot — thanks everyone! :pray: I'll post the request ID once it's up and follow the MDM steps now.

ashley: Welcome again — ping here if anything blocks the first-day flow. We'll make sure you get access for the test project. :slightly_smiling_face:
